meaning: and also; moreover (joins two verbs, adjectives or clauses)

senses.en: and also; moreover (joins two verbs, adjectives or clauses)

note: Joins clauses at the same level; 而且 is the more common spoken twin.

examples.zh: 这家医院很大，并且很干净。
examples.en: This hospital is big, and it is also very clean.

examples.zh: 他听明白了，并且回答了我的问题。
examples.en: He understood and also answered my question.

examples.zh: 这个办法简单并且有用。
examples.en: This method is simple and useful.

meaning: suddenly; sudden, unexpected

senses.en: suddenly; sudden, unexpected

note: 突然 + verb ("suddenly did"); 很突然 = "it was sudden".

examples.zh: 我们正在吃饭，他突然站起来了。
examples.en: We were eating when he suddenly stood up.

examples.zh: 天气突然变冷了，多穿衣服。
examples.en: The weather suddenly turned cold, so wear more clothes.

examples.zh: 这件事太突然了，我没想到。
examples.en: This was so sudden; I didn't expect it.

meaning: finally; at last (after a long wait or effort)

senses.en: finally; at last (after a long wait or effort)

note: Expresses relief after waiting; for unwelcome results use 最后.

examples.zh: 等了两个小时，车终于来了。
examples.en: After waiting two hours, the bus finally came.

examples.zh: 他终于找到工作了，大家都很高兴。
examples.en: He finally found a job, and everyone is happy.

examples.zh: 你终于回来了！我很想你。
examples.en: You're finally back! I missed you.

meaning: to pay (money)

senses.en: to pay (money)

note: Usually 付钱 / 付款; in shops, 付 is also in 支付 and 付费.

examples.zh: 你可以用手机付钱。
examples.en: You can pay with your phone.

examples.zh: 这个菜我来付，你别付了。
examples.en: I'll pay for this dish; don't you pay.

examples.zh: 请问，在哪儿付钱？
examples.en: Excuse me, where do I pay?

meaning: step; pace; stage in a process

senses.en: step; pace; stage in a process

note: 一步一步 = step by step; 走几步 = walk a few steps.

examples.zh: 他向前走了一步。
examples.en: He took one step forward.

examples.zh: 第一步是先买票。
examples.en: The first step is to buy a ticket.

examples.zh: 我们一步一步做吧。
examples.en: Let's do it step by step.

meaning: coffee

senses.en: coffee

note: 一杯咖啡 = a cup of coffee; 咖啡馆 = café.

examples.zh: 我想喝一杯咖啡，不要糖。
examples.en: I'd like a coffee, no sugar.

examples.zh: 你晚上喝咖啡，能睡觉吗？
examples.en: Can you sleep if you drink coffee at night?

examples.zh: 我们去楼下的咖啡店坐一会儿吧。
examples.en: Let's go sit for a while in the café downstairs.

meaning: ability; capability

senses.en: ability; capability

note: 有能力 / 能力强 = capable; often about skills at work.

examples.zh: 她的工作能力很强。
examples.en: She is very capable at work.

examples.zh: 孩子要学会照顾自己，这是一种能力。
examples.en: Children need to learn to look after themselves; it's an ability.

examples.zh: 我没有这个能力做这件事。
examples.en: I don't have the ability to do this.

meaning: to wish (someone something good)

senses.en: to wish (someone something good)

note: 祝 + person + wish: 祝你生日快乐; also used alone, 祝你好运.

examples.zh: 祝你生日快乐！
examples.en: Happy birthday to you!

examples.zh: 祝你一路平安，到了给我打电话。
examples.en: Have a safe trip; call me when you arrive.

examples.zh: 我祝大家新年快乐，身体健康。
examples.en: I wish everyone a happy new year and good health.

meaning: perfect; flawless

senses.en: perfect; flawless

note: Often negated: 不完美 / 没有完美的人.

examples.zh: 世界上没有完美的人。
examples.en: There is no perfect person in the world.

examples.zh: 这次旅行很完美，我很满意。
examples.en: This trip was perfect; I am very satisfied.

examples.zh: 你不用做得那么完美，差不多就行。
examples.en: You don't have to do it so perfectly; roughly is fine.

meaning: goal; objective; target

senses.en: goal; objective; target

note: 定目标 = set a goal; 完成目标 = reach a goal.

examples.zh: 我的目标是今年学会开车。
examples.en: My goal is to learn to drive this year.

examples.zh: 公司今年的目标是卖得更多。
examples.en: The company's goal this year is to sell more.

examples.zh: 你有什么目标吗？
examples.en: Do you have any goals?

meaning: spirit; mind; mental state (the noun, jīngshén)

senses.en: spirit; mind; mental state (the noun, jīngshén)

note: 精神 jīngshén = mind/spirit (精神压力); 精神 jīngshen = energetic (separate entry).

examples.zh: 他最近精神压力很大。
examples.en: He has been under a lot of mental stress lately.

examples.zh: 我们要学习他认真工作的精神。
examples.en: We should learn from his spirit of working seriously.

examples.zh: 身体和精神都要健康。
examples.en: Both body and mind need to be healthy.

meaning: to support; to back; support

senses.en: to support; to back; support

note: 支持 + person/idea; 谢谢你的支持 = thanks for your support.

examples.zh: 我爸爸妈妈都很支持我出国学习。
examples.en: My parents both strongly support me studying abroad.

examples.zh: 你支持哪个队？
examples.en: Which team do you support?

examples.zh: 谢谢大家的支持。
examples.en: Thanks to everyone for your support.

meaning: besides; in addition; also (starts a new point); other

senses.en: besides; in addition; also (starts a new point); other

note: As a sentence opener, 另外 adds a new point; 另外一个 = another one.

examples.zh: 我要一杯茶，另外再来一个面包。
examples.en: I'd like a tea, and also a piece of bread.

examples.zh: 这件衣服太大，有另外的颜色吗？
examples.en: This is too big; do you have other colors?

examples.zh: 另外，明天的会改到下午三点。
examples.en: Also, tomorrow's meeting is moved to 3 p.m.

meaning: to be in charge of; to be responsible for; conscientious

senses.en: to be in charge of; to be responsible for; conscientious

note: 负责 + task/person; 他很负责 = he is conscientious.

examples.zh: 这件事由谁负责？
examples.en: Who is in charge of this?

examples.zh: 我负责买菜，你负责做饭。
examples.en: I'm in charge of buying groceries; you're in charge of cooking.

examples.zh: 王老师对学生很负责。
examples.en: Teacher Wang is very conscientious toward her students.

meaning: everyone; all of you (polite, for an audience)

senses.en: everyone; all of you (polite, for an audience)

note: Used to address a group: 各位老师, 各位来宾; polite and a bit formal.

examples.zh: 各位请坐，会议马上开始。
examples.en: Everyone please sit down; the meeting starts soon.

examples.zh: 各位同事，下午三点开会。
examples.en: Everyone, meeting at 3 p.m.

examples.zh: 谢谢各位今天来参加。
examples.en: Thank you all for coming today.

meaning: mistake, error; wrong, mistaken

senses.en: mistake, error; wrong, mistaken

note: As noun: 犯错误 = make a mistake; as adjective: 错误的 想法. Less casual than 错.

examples.zh: 这个句子里有一个错误。
examples.en: There is a mistake in this sentence.

examples.zh: 我的想法是错误的，对不起。
examples.en: My thinking was wrong; sorry.

examples.zh: 每个人都会有错误。
examples.en: Everyone has made mistakes.

meaning: why; what for; what are you doing (casual)

senses.en: why; what for; what are you doing (casual)

note: Colloquial. 你干吗? = what are you doing? / why? Tone can sound sharp.

examples.zh: 你在干吗？怎么不接电话？
examples.en: What are you doing? Why didn't you pick up?

examples.zh: 你干吗买这么多东西？
examples.en: Why did you buy so much stuff?

examples.zh: 周末你想干吗？
examples.en: What do you want to do this weekend?

meaning: report (document or talk); to report to someone

senses.en: report (document or talk); to report to someone

note: 写报告, 做报告 (give a talk), 向领导报告 (report to a boss).

examples.zh: 我今天要写一份报告。
examples.en: I have to write a report today.

examples.zh: 明天下午有一个报告，你去吗？
examples.en: There's a talk tomorrow afternoon; are you going?

examples.zh: 有问题要及时向经理报告。
examples.en: If there is a problem, report it to the manager promptly.

meaning: experience (what one has been through); to go through

senses.en: experience (what one has been through); to go through

note: 经历 = what happened to you (一段经历); 经验 = skill gained from practice.

examples.zh: 这是一段好经历。
examples.en: This is a good experience.

examples.zh: 他经历过很多困难，现在很好。
examples.en: He has gone through many hardships; now he is doing well.

examples.zh: 你能说一说你的工作经历吗？
examples.en: Can you tell me about your work experience?

meaning: humankind; the human race

senses.en: humankind; the human race

note: Collective noun, no measure word; common in science and news.

examples.zh: 人类需要干净的水和空气。
examples.en: Humans need clean water and air.

examples.zh: 这种病对人类的影响很大。
examples.en: This disease has a big impact on humankind.

examples.zh: 科学让人类的生活越来越好。
examples.en: Science makes human life better and better.
